verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 4.99
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 4.99

verses.pali: 10. Asuravagga
verses.english: 10. Titans

verses.pali: Sikkhāpadasutta
verses.english: Training Rules

verses.pali: “Cattārome, bhikkhave, puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmiṁ.
verses.english: “Mendicants, these four individuals are found in the world.

verses.pali: Katame cattāro?
verses.english: What four?

verses.pali: attahitāya paṭipanno no parahitāya,
verses.english: One who practices to benefit themselves, but not others;

verses.pali: parahitāya paṭipanno no attahitāya,
verses.english: one who practices to benefit others, but not themselves;

verses.pali: nevattahitāya paṭipanno no parahitāya,
verses.english: one who practices to benefit neither themselves nor others; and

verses.pali: attahitāya ceva paṭipanno parahitāya ca.
verses.english: one who practices to benefit both themselves and others.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno hoti, no parahitāya?
verses.english: And how does an individual practice to benefit themselves, but not others?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo attanā pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, no paraṁ pāṇātipātā veramaṇiyā samādapeti;
verses.english: It’s when an individual doesn’t kill living creatures, steal, commit sexual misconduct, lie, or consume beer, wine, and liquor intoxicants. But they don’t encourage others to do the same.

verses.pali: attanā adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, no paraṁ adinnādānā veramaṇiyā samādapeti;
attanā kāmesumicchācārā paṭivirato hoti, no paraṁ kāmesumicchācārā veramaṇiyā samādapeti;
attanā musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, no paraṁ musāvādā veramaṇiyā samādapeti;
attanā surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti, no paraṁ surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā veramaṇiyā samādapeti.
Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno hoti, no parahitāya.
verses.english: That’s how an individual practices to benefit themselves, but not others.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo parahitāya paṭipanno hoti, no attahitāya?
verses.english: And how does an individual practice to benefit others, but not themselves?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo attanā pāṇātipātā appaṭivirato hoti, paraṁ pāṇātipātā veramaṇiyā samādapeti;
verses.english: It’s when an individual kills living creatures, steals, commits sexual misconduct, lies, and consumes beer, wine, and liquor intoxicants. But they encourage others to not do these things.

verses.pali: attanā adinnādānā appaṭivirato hoti, paraṁ adinnādānā veramaṇiyā samādapeti;
attanā kāmesumicchācārā appaṭivirato hoti, paraṁ kāmesumicchācārā veramaṇiyā samādapeti;
attanā musāvādā appaṭivirato hoti, paraṁ musāvādā veramaṇiyā samādapeti;
attanā surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā appaṭivirato hoti, paraṁ surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā veramaṇiyā samādapeti.
Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo parahitāya paṭipanno hoti, no attahitāya.
verses.english: That’s how an individual practices to benefit others, but not themselves.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo nevattahitāya paṭipanno hoti no parahitāya?
verses.english: And how does a person practice to benefit neither themselves nor others?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo attanā pāṇātipātā appaṭivirato hoti, no paraṁ pāṇātipātā veramaṇiyā samādapeti …pe… attanā surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā appaṭivirato hoti, no paraṁ surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā veramaṇiyā samādapeti.
verses.english: It’s when an individual kills, etc. … and doesn’t encourage others to not do these things.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo nevattahitāya paṭipanno hoti, no parahitāya.
verses.english: That’s how an individual practices to benefit neither themselves nor others.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo attahitāya ceva paṭipanno hoti parahitāya ca?
verses.english: And how does an individual practice to benefit both themselves and others?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo attanā ca pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, parañca pāṇātipātā veramaṇiyā samādapeti …pe… attanā ca surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti, parañca surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā veramaṇiyā samādapeti.
verses.english: It’s when an individual doesn’t kill, etc. … and encourages others to do the same.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo attahitāya ceva paṭipanno hoti parahitāya ca.
verses.english: That’s how an individual practices to benefit both themselves and others.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmin”ti.
verses.english: These are the four individuals found in the world.”

verses.pali: Navamaṁ.
